ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 7 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 6
   C. 12
   D. 5

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 19
   C. 7
   D. 17

3. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 24
   C. 10
   D. 25

4. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 73
   B. 1
   C. 72
   D. 17

5. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 4

6. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 0
   C. 17
   D. 8

7. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 18

8. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 36
   D. 42

9. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 3, 6, 9
   B. 1, 2, 3, 6
   C. 1, 6
   D. 2, 4, 6

10. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 57
   B. 56
   C. 15
   D. 1

11. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

12. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 13
   C. 3
   D. 41

13. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 48
   D. 144

14. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 11
   C. 22
   D. 121

15. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 170
   C. 13
   D. 26

16. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 12
   C. 32
   D. 33

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
